    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">最新版Flutter3.38+Dart3.10仿写抖音APP直播+短视频+聊天应用程序</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(255, 44, 85, 1)">25年12月爆肝<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">flutter3.38+getx</span>纯手搓集成<strong>直播+聊天+短视频</strong>app商城系统。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>flutter3_douyin</strong>：基于最新款跨平台框架<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 255, 1)">flutter3.38.2+dart3.10+getx+media_kit</span>开发高性能<strong>仿抖音app界面短视频+直播+聊天</strong>app软件。实现<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)">抖音短视频页面上下滑动小视频/左右滑动页面模块、直播间进场/礼物侧边滑入动效</span>。</span></p>
<p><img alt="未标题-1_2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202512/1289798-20251205221017582-1229875846.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>技术栈</h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">编辑器：VScode</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">技术框架：flutter3.38.2+Dart3.10.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">路由状态管理：get: ^4.7.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">本地缓存服务：get_storage: ^2.1.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">瀑布流组件：flutter_staggered_grid_view^0.7.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">轮播图组件：card_swiper^3.0.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">toast弹窗组件：shirne_dialog^4.8.6</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">视频套件：media_kit: ^1.2.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">svg图片：flutter_svg: ^2.2.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">缓存网络图片：cached_network_image: ^3.4.1</span></li>
</ul>

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化get_storage存储</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  await GetStorage.init();

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化media_kit视频套件</span>

  MediaKit.ensureInitialized();

  runApp(const MyApp());
}

class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const MyApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否windows平台</span>

      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (kIsWeb) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
      
      final platform </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Theme.of(context).platform;
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> platform ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TargetPlatform.windows;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetMaterialApp(

      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      theme: ThemeData(
        colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: const Color(</span>0xFFFF2C55<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),
        useMaterial3: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 修复windows下字体不一致情况 - Web 平台特殊处理</span>

        fontFamily: isWindows() ? 'Microsoft YaHei' : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      ),
      home: const Layout(),

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      getPages: routePages,

}</span></pre>

<h3>Flutter3全屏沉浸式轮播图/Tab吸附菜单</h3>
<p><img alt="p2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202512/1289798-20251205222045866-1795191105.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">轮播图拉伸到顶部状态栏，实现全屏沉浸式效果。滚动页面<strong>tab栏固定吸附</strong>效果。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">CustomScrollView</span>&nbsp;组件滚动，配合&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">SliverAppBar</span>&nbsp;实现顶部灯箱图功能，&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">SliverPersistentHeader</span>&nbsp;组件实现Tab菜单固定吸附效果。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

  backgroundColor: Colors.grey[</span>50<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
  body: ScrollConfiguration(
    behavior: CustomScrollBehavior().copyWith(scrollbars: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),

      scrollBehavior: CustomScrollBehavior().copyWith(scrollbars: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),

                                top: MediaQuery.of(context).padding.top </span>+ 7<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

                                right: </span>0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直播间头像</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                    Container(
                                      ...
                                    ),
                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 排名统计</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                    Container(
                                      ...
                                    ),
                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 红包活动</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                    Container(
                                      ...
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 底部区域</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                              Positioned(
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 商品购买动效</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                    Container(
                                      ...
                                    ),

                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 送礼物动效</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                    AnimationLiveGift(
                                      giftQueryList: [
                                        {</span>'label': '小心心', 'gift': 'assets/images/gift/gift1.png', 'user': 'Jack', 'avatar': 'assets/images/avatar/img02.jpg', 'num': 12<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
                                        {</span>'label': '棒棒糖', 'gift': 'assets/images/gift/gift2.png', 'user': 'Andy', 'avatar': 'assets/images/avatar/img06.jpg', 'num': 36<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
                                        {</span>'label': '大啤酒', 'gift': 'assets/images/gift/gift3.png', 'user': '一条咸鱼', 'avatar': 'assets/images/avatar/img01.jpg', 'num': 162<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
                                        ...
                                      ],
                                    ),

                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加入直播间动效</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                    AnimationLiveJoin(
                                      joinQueryList: [
                                        {</span>'avatar': 'assets/images/logo.png', 'name': 'andy'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
                                        {</span>'avatar': 'assets/images/logo.png', 'name': 'jack'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
                                        ...
                                      ],

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                    Container(
                                      margin: EdgeInsets.only(top: </span>7.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                                      height: </span>200.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

                                        ...
                                      ),

                                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 底部工具栏</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                    Container(
                                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: </span>7.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),

                },

}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Okay，综上就是flutter3.38+dart3.10搭建短视频/直播/聊天app项目的一些知识分享，希望对大家有所帮助！</p>
